newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in moderate trade with most traders sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. Federal Reserve's Beige Book report, dealers said on Wednesday.

The Beige Book, the Fed's account of business conditions around the U.S., is expected to say what the market has already discerned, that the U.S. economy has slowed down a bit in the second quarter, dealers said.
"Rates were steady to higher in the morning on some position adjustments. The Beige Book report is expected later tonight but most people are not expecting much," a local dealer said.
"Also there's some market belief that the Fed will not be moving (U.S.) interest rates at the July FOMC (Federal Open Market Committee) meeting," he said.

In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, Thursday/Friday was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-5/8 5-1/2 and week-fixed rose 1/16 point to 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-3/4 5-5/8, nine-months unchanged at 5-15/16 5-13/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/16 5-15/16 percent. - P. Theseira (65-870-3085)
